questions: Whether a measured reference-capacity or baseline-capacity operation is explicitly identified
Whether the below-1.4-Ah records are explained despite the stated end-of-life stopping threshold
Whether 2.0 Ah is supported as the denominator for a rated-capacity ratio
Whether the first-ten-capacity median is documented as a measured reference

facts: Describes the experiments as run-to-failure time series collected at different temperatures and under different operational profiles.
States EOL as 30% fade in rated capacity, from 2 Ah to 1.4 Ah.
Defines the MATLAB discharge Capacity field in Ah for discharge to 2.7 V.
Explains that discharge current levels and preset voltage thresholds varied; some thresholds were below the OEM-recommended 2.7 V.
Notes differences in depth of discharge, rest duration, and intrinsic variability, and says batteries do not have the same state of life at the same cycle index.
Does not identify any B0005 cycle as a reference-performance test or provide a cell-specific measured baseline capacity.
Does not recommend the first ten positive discharge values, their median, or any other initial-cycle statistic as a reference.
Groups batteries 5, 6, 7, and 18 as room-temperature tests.
Documents charging at 1.5 A CC to 4.2 V, then CV until current falls to 20 mA.
Documents B0005 discharge at 2 A CC to 2.7 V.
Describes the Capacity field as battery capacity in Ah for discharge to 2.7 V.
States rated capacity as 2 Ah and the group EOL criterion as 30% fade, from 2 Ah to 1.4 Ah.
Does not designate a B0005 baseline or identify any cycle as a reference-capacity test.
Does not explain why testing continued below the stated 1.4 Ah stopping criterion.

verified_facts: B0005.mat contains 616 operations: 170 charge, 168 discharge, and 278 impedance operations.
The 168 discharge Capacity records are finite and positive, and all have 24 C ambient-temperature metadata.
The measured discharge capacities span 1.2874525221 to 1.8564874208 Ah.
The first measured discharge capacity is 1.8564874208 Ah; it is not 2 Ah and is not identified in the local records as a reference test.
The first-ten-positive-capacity median is 1.8352043353 Ah; the local records do not identify those cycles as reference tests.
44 recorded discharge capacities are below 1.4 Ah. The first is source cycle index 449 at 1.3967008233 Ah; the last recorded capacity is 1.3250793286 Ah.
The raw cycle array, source cycle indices, and measured capacities reconcile with the prior B0005 evidence report.

derived_rated_capacity_ratio_check.definition: 100 * measured discharge Capacity (Ah) / 2.0 Ah documented rated capacity
derived_rated_capacity_ratio_check.interpretation: These values are arithmetic ratios to the documented rated capacity. They are not ratios to a measured B0005 baseline and are not labeled measured-reference SOH.

other_local_nasa_readmes.relevance: They describe other battery groups and show that test conditions and some group endpoint statements differ. They provide no B0005-specific baseline designation and no explanation for B0005 records below 1.4 Ah.

explicit_b0005_measured_reference_or_bas.finding: No explicit designation was found in the official dataset page, the local B0005 group README, the B0005 raw cycle metadata, or the two existing NASA evidence reports.
explicit_b0005_measured_reference_or_bas.unresolved: A B0005 experiment schedule or curator record may exist outside the reviewed local source materials; no such record is present in the reviewed project files.

reason_for_below_eol_records.finding: The README and official page state a 1.4 Ah EOL stopping point, while 44 recorded B0005 discharge values are below 1.4 Ah. The reviewed records do not explain the discrepancy.
reason_for_below_eol_records.possible_explanations: None asserted. The evidence does not distinguish an approximate threshold, a changed stopping rule, continued testing, or a documentation/data mismatch.

2_ah_denominator_for_rated_capacity_rati.finding: The official page and README explicitly describe 2 Ah as rated capacity and use 1.4 Ah as 30% fade from that rating. The B0005 README describes a 2 A discharge to 2.7 V, matching the stated Capacity-field cutoff.
2_ah_denominator_for_rated_capacity_rati.decision: Supported for a B0005 capacity-to-documented-rated-capacity ratio, provided the target is named exactly as a rated-capacity ratio and the group-level rating and protocol limitations are disclosed.
2_ah_denominator_for_rated_capacity_rati.limitation: The source does not establish that 2 Ah is a separately measured initial capacity for this particular cell or a cell-specific reference-performance result. Therefore this denominator must not be presented as measured-reference SOH.

first_ten_median_as_reference.finding: No official or local documentation reviewed designates the first ten positive measurements or their median as a reference test or baseline.
first_ten_median_as_reference.additional_concern: The first observed value is itself below the documented 2 Ah rating, and documentation does not establish that the sequence begins with a separately conditioned beginning-of-life reference test.

target_and_modeling_constraints.recommended_target_name: B0005 discharge capacity as percent of documented rated capacity
target_and_modeling_constraints.definition: 100 * measured discharge Capacity (Ah) / 2.0 Ah documented rated capacity
target_and_modeling_constraints.explicit_non_equivalence: This is a capacity-to-rated-capacity ratio, not measured-reference SOH and not proof of a cell-specific beginning-of-life capacity.
target_and_modeling_constraints.prediction_time_contract: For a next-discharge prediction made before that discharge begins, use only information available before the target discharge. Exclude the target discharge Capacity and all target-discharge trace samples or derived statistics, future operations, and target-derived denominator values.
target_and_modeling_constraints.evaluation: Use chronological evaluation and do not randomly distribute cycles from B0005 across train and test. A single cell does not establish generalization to other cells.
target_and_modeling_constraints.below_eol_handling: Do not silently remove or clip the 44 below-1.4-Ah observations. Any model or evaluation using the series must disclose the conflict with the stated stopping rule and preserve source-cycle provenance.
target_and_modeling_constraints.measured_reference_soh_training: Remains blocked unless a designated, condition-matched B0005 measured reference is obtained.

recommendation.decision: Proceed with a clearly named capacity-to-rated-capacity prediction target for B0005, subject to the definition, prediction-time leakage rules, and limitations recorded above. Do not describe this target as measured-reference SOH.
recommendation.scope: This is a recommendation for a distinct prediction estimand; this investigation did not create labels, alter existing artifacts, or train a model.
follow_up: Keep the 44 below-threshold readings visible and flag the unexplained EOL discrepancy in any downstream dataset or evaluation.
If measured-reference SOH is still required, request the cell-specific reference-performance schedule and the explanation of continued testing below 1.4 Ah from the NASA PCoE dataset custodian.
